turns.content: Identify the organotitanium reagent formed from Cp2TiCl2 and methyllithium, and state its characteristic alkene-forming reaction.
Apply that reaction to camphor to describe product 2.
Explain how zinc and trichloroacetyl chloride generate dichloroketene and how it reacts with the exocyclic alkene to give product 3.
Identify the two most deshielded protons in product 3 and determine whether they are chemically equivalent and whether any vicinal hydrogens couple to them.
Use the relevant proton-proton coupling to predict the multiplicity of each of those two signals.
Check the assignments against the cyclobutanone connectivity and the absence of vicinal hydrogens.
